newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Electra Consumer warns of Q4 loss.
newsitem.headline: Electra Consumer warns of Q4 loss.

text.p: Israel's Electra Consumer Products Ltd, a subsidiary of Elco Holdings Ltd, said on Monday it would report a "significant" loss in the fourth quarter of 1996.
The company told the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange it would report a 30 percent decline in revenues compared with the year-earlier period, citing a slowdown in domestic economic activity.
The company also attributed the decline to weather conditions in Israel and Europe and lower product prices. It also cited one-time charges that it would be recording for the quarter.
Electra Consumer makes heaters, air conditioners, ovens and parts.
